cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the underlying course, principle, or path by which things operate or are followed
cards.Nuance (English): In this text it refers to the fundamental Way, not an ordinary road.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to put something into words or articulate it verbally
cards.Nuance (English): Often used for stating, describing, or mentioning something in a concise way.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): People do not speak of right and wrong.|He stated his purpose.|I spoke of it to the others.|The sage does not speak his name.
cards.Sentences: 人不道是非。|子道其志。|吾道之於眾。|聖人不道其名。

cards.Nuance (English): Marks what is possible or admissible, not what actually happens.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to judge something acceptable or good, or to sanction it
cards.Nuance (English): Usually takes an object or complement meaning the thing approved.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The ruler approved the plan.|The crowd approved his words.|The lord approved it.|The teacher approved the strategy.
cards.Sentences: 王可其議。|眾可其言。|君可之。|師可其策。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): marks simple negation or contradiction of a following predicate
cards.Nuance (English): A direct negative marker, not an independent judgment word here.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to condemn, criticize, or judge as wrong
cards.Nuance (English): Expresses adverse judgment of a person or act.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The people blamed him.|The father blamed his son.|The world criticized my conduct.|The lord condemned the plan.
cards.Sentences: 眾非之。|父非其子。|世非吾行。|君非其謀。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A way or course that is enduring and unchanging; the stable normative Way.
cards.Nuance (English): Combines permanence with the sense of the Way as a guiding principle, not a merely ordinary habit.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): a word or designation used to identify or refer to something
cards.Nuance (English): Here it is the designation itself, contrasted with the named reality or Way.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to give a designation to, or mention by name
cards.Nuance (English): Takes a direct object or a thing named.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The ruler named his son.|The master named this mountain.|People named it righteousness.|The lord named his state.
cards.Sentences: 王名其子。|師名此山。|人名之曰義。|君名其國。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A fixed or enduring designation, as opposed to a changeable one.
cards.Nuance (English): Emphasizes permanence in naming, not simply an ordinary name.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): Marks the absence or nonexistence of what follows; also forms negative predicative constructions.
cards.Nuance (English): In the Laozi it often opposes 有 and points to absence as a condition or principle.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.
cards.Sentences: S無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): Used before a noun to mean there is none or none of the thing in question.
cards.Nuance (English): Negates the existence or presence of the noun it modifies.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): No one has arrived.|There is nothing to say.|Travel without a cart.|A thing without a name.
cards.Sentences: 無人至。|無事可言。|無車而行。|無名之物。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): Nonbeing, absence, or the state of there being nothing.
cards.Nuance (English): Treats absence itself as a substantive notion.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Nonbeing arises from being.|Change arises from nothing.|Hold to emptiness.|Know its absence.
cards.Sentences: 無生於有。|無中生變。|守其無。|知其無也。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The totality of the cosmos, often used as a pair for the whole natural world.
cards.Nuance (English): A paired cosmic expression, not simply two separate nouns in this usage.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.
cards.Sentences: S無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A genitive or attributive particle linking one noun to another, marking possession, relation, or modification.
cards.Nuance (English): Here it links a noun to the head noun that follows, without carrying independent lexical content.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.
cards.Sentences: S無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A third-person pronoun referring to a previously mentioned or contextually understood person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used as an object pronoun or after certain verbs and prepositions.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To move toward or depart for a place.
cards.Nuance (English): A directional verb, not a genitive particle.
cards.Register (English): Classical Chinese; received Laozi/Wang Bi recension
cards.Sentence Translations (English): I go east.|The gentleman goes to the city.|The man goes to the market.|The horse goes to the plain.
cards.Sentences: 吾之東。|士之城。|人之市。|馬之野。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): the first point, origin, or commencement of something
cards.Nuance (English): Refers to the primal starting-point or source, not merely a moment of onset.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.
cards.Sentences: S無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): to start an action, process, or state
cards.Nuance (English): Denotes the initiation of an activity or change.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The ruler began to govern the state.|Heaven began to rain.|The people began to learn the Way.|I began the matter.
cards.Sentences: 王始治國。|天始雨。|眾始學道。|我始其事。
